subject: spurious warning about files not found when reading with textFile()

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: spurious warning about files not found when reading with textFile()
parts:
I'm getting spurious warnings about files not found when using textFile. This has happened both with reading from S3 and from HDFS.

> hdfs_master <- system("cat /root/ephemeral-hdfs/conf/masters", intern = TRUE)
> lines <- cache(textFile(sc, paste0("hdfs://", hdfs_master, ":9000/data/airline")))
Warning message:
In normalizePath(path) :
  path[1]="hdfs://ec2-54-186-247-68.us-west-2.compute.amazonaws.com:9000/data/airline": No such file or directory

Now that I know to ignore it's not a substantive problem but could easily throw someone off when they get started.

-chris
